description_en: Queries the usage details of a reserved instance (RI)
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi query-ri-utilization-detail --ri-instance-id dsudfgdsjh --instance-spec Instancetyp --ri-commodity-code ecsRi --deducted-instance-id jsdgfsdhgsdjh --start-time 2019-05-23_12:00:00 --end-time 2019-05-23_12:00:00 --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRIUtilizationDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RI. If this parameter is left empty, the usage details of all RIs are queried
parameters.help_zh: 筛选查询的预留实例ID，为空时返回所有的使用的预留实例明细
parameters.name: ri_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the RI
parameters.name: instance_spec

parameters.help_en:
The code of the service to which the RI is applied. Default value: ecsRi. Valid values:

ecsRi: ECS RI.
scu_bag: storage capacity unit (SCU)
parameters.help_zh:
取值：
ecsRi（默认值）：ECS的预留实例。
scu_bag：存储容量单位包
parameters.name: ri_commodity_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance whose fees are deducted by using the RI. If this parameter is left empty, the usage details of all instances are queried
parameters.help_zh: 被抵扣实例的ID，为空时返回所有实例的明细数据
parameters.name: deducted_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the RI was created. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The time when the RI expires. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认为20，最大值为300
parameters.name: page_size

DetailList.description_en: The usage details of the RI

DeductDate.description_en: The time when the fees are deducted by using the RI

DeductFactorTotal.description_en: The total amount of computing power of the RI or capacity of SCU in the time period
DeductFactorTotal.description_zh: RI或SCU在该时间段的算力或容量总量

DeductHours.description_en: The deduct factor. This parameter is returned only if the RICommodityCode parameter is set to ecsRi
DeductHours.description_zh: 抵扣系数。 仅当RICommodityCode为ecsRi有效

DeductQuantity.description_en: The computing power or capacity of the pay-as-you-go instance whose fees are deducted by using the RI
DeductQuantity.description_zh: 实际抵扣对应按量实例的算力或容量

DeductedCommodityCode.description_en: The code of the service whose fees are deducted by using the RI

DeductedInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance whose fees are deducted by using the RI

DeductedProductDetail.description_en: The name of the service whose fees are deducted by using the RI
DeductedProductDetail.description_zh: 被抵商品（产品明细）名称

InstanceSpec.description_en: The instance type of the instance whose fees are deducted by using the RI

PageNum.description_en: The number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
